raw_support_spans.text: Given the high FDG uptake, a preliminary diagnosis of malignant lymphoma or metastatic lymph node was made

counterfactual_missing_items: histologic confirmation of lymphoma from the resected nodule
other lymphadenopathy or B symptoms to support systemic lymphoma
interval growth or additional metastases to support metastatic colon cancer
decisive_items: 20-mm homogeneous, well-defined nodule in the right paratracheal region
no change in the nodule’s size
response.rationale: R1 better fits an isolated, homogeneous, well-defined right paratracheal hypermetabolic node in a patient with pathologic stage I colon cancer and no interval growth. R2 would require an atypical solitary mediastinal metastasis from an early colon cancer, with expected progression or other metastatic disease that is absent.

rejected.why: Metastatic lymph node is less consistent with the isolated right paratracheal location, early pathologic stage of the colon cancer, and 3-month stability without other metastatic disease.
